summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of NXT Energy Solutions Inc.'s Annual Meeting of Shareholders held on June 9, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine matters: election of seven directors, appointment of MNP LLP as auditors, approval of an employee share purchase plan, unallocated entitlements, and a special resolution to cancel Series 2 Preferred Shares. All resolutions passed with over 99% support. There are no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation elements. This is a standard non-special-situation filing that merely discloses meeting outcomes and does not trigger any special-situation category.
